title: Bahram Kesh
_note: A1.4: the Hammer drops his weapon and sits. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

start.speaker: Bahram
start.text: [Heavy, tired, almost respectful. He lets the hammer fall and sits down in the dirt.] You. The farmer. Gods. I did wonder if you'd come.

choices.spoken: Count them. How many did you kill?
You killed my wife in front of me.

leave1.speaker: Bahram
leave1.text: [Flat, looking at your chest.] He said to leave one. Always one. He picked you. He said you had the look.

count.speaker: Bahram
count.text: [Almost a laugh.] You counted the graves, farmer? Did you? ...No. Course you didn't. Nobody counts.

smile.speaker: Bahram
smile.text: [He smiles, and says nothing at all.]
